clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Requirements of spiral seam welded steel pipe over 457 mm dia and upto 2000 mm dia with wall thickness upto 12.5 mm inclusive. The pipe is intended for general use. The suitability of pipe for various purposes is dependent on its dimensions, properties and condition of service. The purpose for which the pipe is intended should be stated in the enquiry and order.

clauses.title: Manufacture – Steel used
clauses.text: 2. Manufacture - Steel used shall be produced by open hearth a electic or one of the basic oxygen processes. The helical seam shall be welded by one of the following processes : a) Electric fusion butt welding internally and automatic are welding externally. b) Electric resistance welding c) Automatic submerged are welding.

clauses.text: 4.2 Flattering Test — Shall withstand the prescribed test.

clauses.text: 4.3 Submerged Arc Weld Test — Shall withstand the prescribed test.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Test
clauses.text: 5. Hydrostatic Test — Shall be tested at mill to a hydrostatic pressure, equal to a minimum of 150 percent of working pressure required. In no case the maximum stress produced exceeds 40 percent of minimum ultimate tensile strength envisaged in the steel. Note —  Steel tensile strength may be assumed as 410 MPa normally and unless otherwise agreed. The pressure shall be calculated from the following equation : P = 2 st/D where P =  test pressure MPa, s =  stress in MPa (normally 40 percent of  410 MPa, that is 164 MPa) t = specified wall thickness in mm, and D = specified outside diameter in mm.

clauses.title: Lengths
clauses.text: 6.1 Lengths —  Steel pipe shall be supplied in single random length between 4 to 7 m or double random length of 7 to 14 m.

clauses.title: Thickness and Diameter
clauses.text: 6.2 Thickness and Diameter — The tolerance on wall thickness shall be +15 percent and 12.5 percent. The tolerance on outside diameter of pipe shall be as follows : Upto 1,000 mm  OD = ±  0.75 percent Over 1,000 mm  OD = ±  1      percent The ovality of pipe shall be with ± 0.75 percent.

clauses.title: Finish
